import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data into a DataFrame
data = {
    "StichtagDat": ["2024-12-31", "2025-12-31", "2019-12-31", "2020-12-31", "2021-12-31"],
    "StichtagDatJahr": [2024, 2025, 2019, 2020, 2021],
    "AlterV10Cd": [30, 30, 30, 30, 30],
    "KreisLang": ["Kreis 7", "Kreis 7", "Kreis 10", "Kreis 10", "Kreis 10"],
    "Rasse1Text": ["Deutsche Dogge", "Deutsche Dogge", "Continental Bulldog", "Continental Bulldog", "Continental Bulldog"],
    "AnzHunde": [1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Set the style of the visualization
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a bar plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x="StichtagDatJahr", y="AnzHunde", hue="KreisLang", data=df, palette="viridis")

# Add labels and title
plt.title("Number of Dogs by Year and Kreis")
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("Number of Dogs")

plt.savefig("output.png")
